focus_areas: Boundary integrity between sock and skin
Absence of reinforced stitching at the toe area
Anatomical correctness of the foot shape inside the sock
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the ribbed cuff and the main body of the sock. Ensure the stripe pattern flows logically around the curvature of the leg without sudden, unexplained breaks or warping. Verify that the heel turn on the right sock has a physically plausible depth. Crucially, examine the toe area closely to confirm if the stitch density is uniform (supporting the 'no reinforcement' verdict) or if there are subtle signs of thickening that were missed.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pair of feet wearing hand-knitted, multi-colored striped socks. The socks feature horizontal stripes in shades of purple, pink, green, and brown. They appear to be crew-length or mid-calf, resting on a light-colored wooden floor with visible grain.
